answer: The defence rests on orchard society membership with harvest yield records: yields recorded for one orchard across years. Forging 447 of these means building 447 separate yield records from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The hollow check runs in the open: 447 fakes pay the full price 447 times, one honest agent pays once, and the pigment trail in the ledger makes the copper cost visible to everyone.
